title: The biggest payer and provider trends from Q2
summary: Fierce Healthcare's Paige Minemyer and Dave Muoio break down the biggest trends shaping payer and provider performance in the second quarter and what to watch next.

title: Common Health Coalition secures $100M from OpenAI Foundation to boost hepatitis C cure rates
summary: Funding will support the deployment of AI-enabled tools to help identify patients who have fallen out of care, reduce administrative burden, strengthen care coordination and improve patient outcomes.

title: Sharp HealthCare announces another reorganization affecting 260 workers
summary: The workforce reduction will reduce the San Diego nonprofit's headcount by just under 1%, but follows last summer's elimination of 315 roles. Leadership attributed the decision to heightened expenses and policy changes at both the federal and state levels.

title: UC San Diego Health, West Health launch $40M accelerator for 'tech-forward' coordinated care
summary: The academic system and the nonprofit plan to develop a scalable model for timely, personalized care delivery, with an emphasis on care navigation and digital health tools.

title: These ‘Masturbation Consultants’ Were Hired to Pleasure Themselves With AI
summary: Joi AI hired 10 people to masturbate using AI companions as part of a monthlong “wellness” study. The company claims the practice could help “solve male loneliness.”

title: Nonprofit hospital recovery may have peaked, Fitch warns
summary: Though the sector’s overall operating margin improved in 2025, some providers lost ground — a worry for underperforming organizations facing looming federal funding cuts.

title: Weekly Rundown: US News rates GLP-1 telehealth platforms; CHAI launches AI cybersecurity work group
summary: Stay up to date on the latest in health tech, digital health and health AI news with this weekly brief.

title: Luigi Mangione pleads guilty in federal case over murder of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson
summary: The man accused of murdering UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson has pleaded guilty in the federal trial against him, per media reports.

title: Rural communities bear the brunt of healthcare workforce shortage: report
summary: With the U.S. already facing a deficit of 86,000 physicians by 2036, healthcare cuts could push more rural hospitals to the brink of closure, according to a new study from staffing firm AMN Healthcare.

title: Premiums, out-of-pocket costs dominate Americans’ healthcare concerns: survey
summary: Respondents were split on who should solve the issues, with Democrats more likely to say the federal government and Republicans more likely to name insurers, according to the Commonwealth Fund.

title: Oracle Health debuts revamped patient portal with an AI upgrade
summary: Oracle Health debuted a revamped digital platform for patients with an artificial intelligence assistant that can explain medical records in plain language and assist with scheduling appointments.

title: Suvi Health launches ambient AI solution for patients to reduce hospital stays and support care transitions
summary: Startup Suvi Health developed an ambient AI platform for patients to close gaps at critical transition points and support the handoff between hospital care teams and patients and their families.

title: Industry Voices—AI should help cancer patients survive the healthcare system
summary: Cancer care navigators are an invaluable resource, but there are nowhere near enough navigators to meet the scale of the need. This is where AI can make a meaningful difference, write the Digital Medicine Society's Jennifer Goldsack and former CMS Chief Medical Officer Lee...

title: Health advocacy group sues AMA to make billing codes public
summary: PatientRightsAdvocate.org is challenging the physician association’s copyright of the current procedural terminology, or CPT, system. Use of the codes is required by law, and that means they should be freely available, per the suit.

title: Assort Health rolls out AI agent to automate referrals for specialty practices and health systems
summary: The tool can process inbound referrals, confirm eligibility and match patients to best-suited providers, the startup says.

title: Epic releases Care Everywhere diagnostic image exchange to tackle healthcare's 'CD problem'
summary: Epic released a new diagnostic image exchange solution that enables healthcare providers at Epic-connected health systems to retrieve and share diagnostic-quality medical images, such as CT scans, X-rays and MRIs, with a single click.

title: Healthcare CFOs face decision readiness gap: Deloitte
summary: The findings could reflect a mismatch between expanding expectations for CFOs and the support systems available to finance teams, Deloitte said.

title: Major PBMs agree to offer TrumpRx pricing information to members
summary: The Pharmaceutical Care Management Association announced Thursday that its members had reached an agreement with the feds to offer information on cash prices available through TrumpRx.

title: Hippocratic AI rolls out platform to coordinate teams of conversational voice AI agents
summary: For health plans, the AI teams support functions such as member onboarding, chronic care management and Star Ratings improvement. Provider-focused offerings target patient onboarding, care gap closure and inpatient and ambulatory workflows.
